blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.prompt: The snow was there for just an hour.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**вторник → вторник** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. вторник · вторника · вторнику · вторник · вторником · вторнике; pl. вторники · вторников · вторникам · вторники · вторниками · вторниках.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Хлеб наш насущный дай нам на ___ (сей день, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: Give us this day our daily bread.
exercises.why: **день → день** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's автомобиль: A. автомобиль. Ending -ь → -ь.  **сей → сей** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with день). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Эту статую воздвигли десять ___ (лёт, acc. sg.) назад.
exercises.prompt: This statue was erected ten years ago.
exercises.why: **лёт → лет** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  Declension: sg. лёт · лёта · лёту · лёт · лётом · лёте; pl. лёты · лётов · лётам · лёты · лётами · лётах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Чистота воды проверяется ___ (каждый час, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: The purity of the water is checked every hour.
exercises.why: **час → час** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a hard consonant — declines like DLI's дом: A. дом. Ending — (no ending) → — (no ending).  **каждый → каждый** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with час). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ый → -ый.  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Что ты делал в ___ (праздник, acc. pl.)?
exercises.prompt: What did you do during the holidays?
exercises.why: **праздник → праздники** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural праздники; declines like DLI's книги (guttural stem): A. книги. Ending — (no ending) → -и.  Declension: sg. праздник · праздника · празднику · праздник · праздником · празднике; pl. праздники · праздников · праздникам · праздники · праздниками · праздниках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Не волнуйтесь, на ___ (сегодняшний день, acc. sg.) косметическая хирургия гораздо лучше, чем во времена доктора Франкенштейна.
exercises.prompt: Don't worry, present day cosmetic surgery is much better than what it used to be in Doctor Frankenstein's days.
exercises.why: **день → день** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's автомобиль: A. автомобиль. Ending -ь → -ь.  **сегодняшний → сегодняшний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with день). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий: A. anim. = G., inan. = N.. Ending -ий → -ий.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: ___ (неделя, acc. sg.) назад мне выдернули зуб.
exercises.prompt: I had a tooth pulled a week ago.
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я — declines like DLI's тётя: A. тётю. Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: ___ (каждая весна, acc. sg.) река здесь разливается.
exercises.prompt: Every spring the river floods here.
exercises.why: **весна → весну** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  **каждый → каждую** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with весну). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новая: A. новую. Ending -ая → -ую.  Declension: sg. весна · весны · весне · весну · весной · весне; pl. вёсны · вёсен · вёснам · вёсны · вёснами · вёснах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

**полдень → полдень** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's автомобиль: A. автомобиль. Ending -ь → -ь.  Declension: sg. полдень · полудня · полудню · полдень · полуднем · полудне; pl. полудни · полудней · полудням · полудни · полуднями · полуднях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Два-три ___ (день, gen. sg.) назад Пномпень затопило.
exercises.prompt: Phnom Penh was flooded two or three days ago.
exercises.why: **день → дня** (gen. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь — declines like DLI's автомобиль: G. автомобиля. Ending -ь → -я, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -я.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  Genitive endings: masculine -а, -я (книга студента, книга учителя); neuter -а, -я (стакан вина, часть здания); feminine -ы, -и (стакан воды, часть семьи, часть тетради). — DLI, Lesson 23.  «Certain masculine nouns have the vowels е or о only in the nominative singular (and in the accusative if inanimate): отец — отца, американец — американца, кусок — куска, звонок — звонка.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Это так обычно с его стороны — смыться в ___ (последняя минута, acc. sg.).
exercises.prompt: It's so typical of him to bail out at the last minute.
exercises.why: **минута → минуту** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -а — declines like DLI's сестра: A. сестру. Ending -а → -у.  **последний → последнюю** (acc. sg. f., agreeing with минуту). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синяя: A. синюю. Ending -яя → -юю.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).
